page.overview:
Who is Jack Aitken?

Jack Aitken (born 23 September 1995) is a British-Korean racing driver, who previously raced in reserve driver for Williams. He made his debut for the team at the 2020 Sakhir Grand Prix, following the announcement of George Russell driving at Mercedes whilst Lewis Hamilton was recovering from COVID-19.
